sheet.title: P&IDS PERMEATE COLLECTION
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: Horizontal bands: SCADA HMI / MBR PLC / MCC. Bubble position gives its location.
Diamond-in-square symbols marked DI, DO, AI, AO are untagged MBR PLC I/O points; they are not recorded as instruments, each is noted on the signal that passes through it.
'VENT TO ATMOSPHERE (TYP)' is printed at XV-080111 only; the identical branch at XV-080112 carries no label.
A boxed '4' is drawn inside pump PMP-080101; no note list is on this sheet.
Flag 'a PERMEATE TO DISINFECTION' carries no 'REF SHT' drawing reference.
Sheet 13 of 25. CAD filename P-200 P&IDS.DWG. No revisions entered in revision table. No line numbers or pipe sizes are printed.

equipment.name: Permeate pump (no descriptive name printed)
equipment.notes: Only the tag PMP-080101 is printed. A boxed '4' is drawn inside the pump casing; its meaning is not given on this sheet.

components.notes: Valve body drawn as bow-tie with a circle in the middle (ball-type) on the vertical vent branch; box marked S joined by a solid line to field bubble XV 080111. 'VENT TO ATMOSPHERE (TYP)' printed above.

Same symbol as XV-080111 on a vertical branch off the main line; tag printed both in field bubble XV 080112 and as text XV-080112 beside the valve. No destination label (the VENT TO ATMOSPHERE note at XV-080111 is marked TYP).
Bubble FCV 080132 above a box marked M on a valve body drawn as two end bars with a diagonal and centre dot (same body symbol as V2, V4).

On the main line between the pump suction tee and the pump discharge return (pump bypass). Symbol: two end bars with a diagonal arrow and a dot at its foot; read as check valve, no legend on this sheet.
Pump suction isolation. Symbol: two end bars with a diagonal and centre dot; read as butterfly valve, no legend on this sheet.
Wavy-sided symbol between two bars on pump suction (flexible connector / expansion joint; no legend on this sheet).
Unlabelled reducer at pump suction; no size printed.
Unlabelled reducer at pump discharge; no size printed.
Wavy-sided symbol between two bars on pump discharge (flexible connector / expansion joint; no legend on this sheet).
Pump discharge. Same symbol as V1 (end bars, diagonal arrow, dot at foot); read as check valve.
Pump discharge isolation. Same symbol as V2 (end bars, diagonal, centre dot); read as butterfly valve.
On the turbidity sample side-stream. Bow-tie with a small filled triangle on one side; valve type not identified (no legend on this sheet).
Unlabelled reducer upstream of FCV-080132; no size printed.
Unlabelled reducer downstream of FCV-080132; no size printed.
Unlabelled reducer on the vertical drop after FCV-080132; no size printed.
Unlabelled reducer where the drop joins the bottom horizontal line to flag a; no size printed.

Bubble drawn touching the top of AE-080001.

lines.notes: Main permeate line: from flag B, joined by the line from flag C, right along the header (vent XV-080111 branch, PT-080121 tap, pump suction tee), through bypass valve V1, pump discharge return tee, vent XV-080112 branch, FE-080141, sample tee, R3, FCV-080132, R4, then down (R5), left, down (R6) onto a horizontal line that runs right to flag a. That bottom horizontal line extends a short stub left of the R6 junction ending in a bar (capped end). No flow arrows on the main line; direction from flag texts and the pump arrow.
Lower permeate line from flag C; joins the line from flag B at a common vertical header before the first vent branch.
Vertical branch up from the header through XV-080111, labelled VENT TO ATMOSPHERE (TYP).
Pump suction: tees down off the header downstream of the PT-080121 tap; filled arrowhead into the pump.
Pump discharge returning up to the main line downstream of V1.
Vertical branch up from the main line (between the pump discharge return and FE-080141) through XV-080112; ends open above the valve with no label.
Side-stream teeing down off the main line after FE-080141, across, up through V5 to a short header where AE-080001 connects, then a filled arrow down to DRAIN.
